title: How OpenAI o3 reasoning model changes software development forever

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: OpenAI o3 makes software dev faster by automating code generation and debugging with advanced reasoning. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: OpenAI o3 is just a research model—no real deployment tools or integration with existing protocols like REST or GraphQL. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: o3's reasoning reduces manual coding by 70% and cuts bugs by 50% in real-world apps like Azure and GitHub Copilot. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: OpenAI isn’t open—its models are closed-source, limiting transparency and stifling innovation outside their ecosystem. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Open source wins—true progress happens when everyone can build on it, not just a few. (4 sec)
